hero.title: Awards and recognition
hero.answerBlock: Calwebtech's work has been recognised by Awwwards, Clutch, the W3 Awards and the Horizon Interactive Awards, for ecommerce design, accessibility and B2B development. Each award below names the year and, where it recognised a single project, the client project behind it.
hero.intro: Awards are a second opinion, not a substitute for results. We list each one with the project behind it where there is one, so you can read the case study and judge the work yourself.

faq.heading: What do people ask about our awards?

awards.name: Awwwards Honourable Mention
awards.description: For the Verona Home storefront: a furniture brand moved off a page builder and replatformed on Shopify, with a configurator for made-to-order pieces.

awards.name: Clutch Top B2B Developer
awards.description: Listed among the top B2B development companies in California by Clutch, the B2B review platform, for the second year running.

awards.name: W3 Silver, Accessibility
awards.description: For the Cascadia Health platform: fourteen clinic sites merged into one accessible website with location-aware appointment booking, verified against WCAG 2.2 AA.

awards.name: Horizon Interactive, Gold
awards.description: For the Northmark Supply quoting platform: a catalogue of 40,000 parts rebuilt as a searchable, account-priced quoting system tied into the client's ERP.

awards.name: Clutch Top B2B Developer
awards.description: Listed among the top B2B development companies in California by Clutch, the B2B review platform.

partners.name: Shopify
partners.meaningForClient: Your store is designed, built and extended by a team that has worked in Shopify's partner programme since 2019. Themes and apps are chosen for what your catalogue needs, and the store is transferred into your ownership at launch.

partners.name: Google
partners.meaningForClient: Analytics, Search Console and advertising accounts are set up by people who work with Google's measurement tools every week. Conversion tracking is tested before launch, so the enquiries in your reports are the enquiries in your inbox.

partners.name: Vercel
partners.meaningForClient: When managed hosting suits a Next.js project, we deploy it on Vercel with previews for every change. When a server in your own name suits it better, we build for Docker instead, and the proposal explains the choice.

partners.name: Cloudflare
partners.meaningForClient: DNS, TLS, caching and bot protection are configured to a written checklist before launch. Public forms are checked with Cloudflare Turnstile, which filters spam without making real visitors solve a puzzle.

faqs.question: Do awards matter when choosing a web development agency?
faqs.answer: Less than results do. An award tells you that people outside the studio rated the work; a case study tells you what the work did for the client. Use awards to build a shortlist, and case studies with measured figures to decide.

faqs.question: What is the Clutch Top B2B Developer listing?
faqs.answer: A regional listing published by Clutch, the B2B review platform, which draws largely on verified client reviews on its site. Calwebtech was listed among B2B development companies in California in 2025 and again in 2026.

faqs.question: What did the W3 Silver award for accessibility recognise?
faqs.answer: The Cascadia Health platform, which merged fourteen clinic websites into one accessible site with location-aware appointment booking. The platform was verified against WCAG 2.2 AA, the standard we work to on every project.

faqs.question: Can I read about the projects behind these awards?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Verona Home, Cascadia Health and Northmark Supply projects are published as case studies, with the brief, the build and the figures each client agreed to publish.
